newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turks arrested for smuggling heroin to Britain.
newsitem.headline: Turks arrested for smuggling heroin to Britain.

text.p: Turkish police arrested four Turks in the Western port city of Izmir for smuggling of 600 kg (1320 lb) of heroin to Britain, a police statement said on Wednesday.
It said the detainees were "members of an international drug smuggling group" of which four other members, also Turks, were arrested last month in London with a 436 kg (960 lb) heroin haul.
It was not clear when the smuggling occurred.
The heroin consignments were hidden in container vehicles belonging to a Turkish textile company and later hidden at the depot of a company in London, it said.
Turkey is on the so-called Balkan route of drugs trading which is used to supply the West with narcotics from Asia and the Middle East.
